public_rationale: On Friday, June 5, 2026, the Nasdaq fell 4.18%, its worst day since April 2025, and the Dow fell 1.35%, as Marcus said. A Yahoo Finance screen that day showed chip stocks alone losing about $1.2 trillion in market value. So at least half a trillion dollars of tech value did disappear in one session. His figure understates the loss rather than overstating it. Read as a rough size estimate, the claim holds. A strict reading of the number would call it too low, which is why the reading matters here.
limitations: The chip-stock loss figure was measured during the session, not at the close.
There is no single agreed figure for the whole tech industry.
Under a strict reading, a loss more than twice the stated figure could be called inaccurate.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Reliable reporting shows tech losses that day well below roughly $500 billion (for example under $250 billion), or no large selloff on that day.
